request.tone: mystery and puzzle-solving friendship; scariness mild, peril mild, violence none

pitch.hero: Mara, Theo and Lin: a puzzle-lover, a climber and a careful friend at a silent clocktower
pitch.want: to solve the cipher pinned to the tower door and find what its maker hid
pitch.obstacle: a locked tower built to test entrants, fading light, a narrow ledge, and traps for the rash and greedy
pitch.stake: being locked out for the night, jamming the clock, or being caught taking what is not theirs
pitch.ending_kind: branch and bottleneck: three ways in, four ways up, then share, keep or grab; setbacks send them home

mara.name: Mara
mara.want: to crack Eda's cipher the patient way
mara.voice: third person; eager, breathless over puzzles, works with pencil and cipher wheel

theo.name: Theo
theo.want: to get up and in fast
theo.voice: impatient, grinning, quick to act and quick to own his mistakes

lin.name: Lin
lin.want: to keep the three of them safe and respect what is Eda's
lin.voice: quiet, cautious, speaks softly at moments of wonder

keeper.name: the clockkeeper
keeper.role: old man who tends the tower and tells Eda's story
keeper.want: for worthy finders to solve Eda's tower
keeper.voice: ink-stained, sharp and kind, says little and means it

eda.name: Eda
eda.role: offstage clockmaker who built the tower and its puzzles
eda.want: for someone patient and kind to find what she hid
eda.voice: speaks only through her cipher, letter and devices

truth.question: Who built the clocktower's cipher, and what does it guard?
truth.statement: Eda, the town's great clockmaker, built the clocktower as a puzzle to guard a secret the town nearly lost. The cipher names a time; setting the clock hands to it opens a vault behind the clockface holding her sealed letter, which tells where the original town charter and the lost spring were hidden during a long-ago flood. A faint scratched sequence on a hidden dial behind the clockface leads instead to her private workshop.

tower_frozen.text: The old clocktower has not chimed in years; its great brass hands are frozen at twelve.

front_door_locked.text: The clocktower's front door, solid oak, is locked tight.

three_friends.text: Mara, Theo and Lin are three friends standing at the foot of the clocktower steps.

cipher_note.text: A square of paper covered in rows of strange symbols, a cipher, is pinned to the front door with a brass tack.

mara_loves_puzzles.text: Mara loves puzzles more than anything.

keep_out_sign.text: A warning sign half buried in ivy reads KEEP OUT.

note_meant_to_be_found.text: Mara reasons that someone pinned the code to the locked door because they wanted it found and solved.

clockkeeper_nearby.text: An old clockkeeper still lives near the tower.

cipher_first_line_cracked.text: The cipher is a simple substitution; Mara cracks its first line and part of the second.

key_under_third_stone.text: The note's first line reads THE KEY SLEEPS BENEATH THE THIRD STONE: a key is hidden in the front steps.

loose_grate.text: The note's second line includes A LOOSE GRATE BREATHES: a loose grate is another way in.

note_in_mara_pocket.text: Mara folds the note and keeps it in her pocket.

side_door_swollen.text: Around the side of the tower is a smaller door swollen shut in its frame that gives slightly under Theo's shoulder.

high_window_climb.text: A narrow window stands cracked open three storeys up, reachable by a drainpipe and carved stone ledges.

keeper_knows_note.text: The clockkeeper knows about the note; people find it now and then and most give up.

tower_built_to_test.text: The tower was built to test whoever entered it, and it still does.

keeper_can_unlock.text: The clockkeeper can unlock the tower door but will not climb its stairs himself.

cipher_has_builder.text: A particular person built the cipher into the tower.

brass_key_found.text: Under the cracked third stair, in a felt-lined hollow, lay an ornate brass key with a clockface head; Lin carries it.

clockmaker_built.text: The tower was built by a clockmaker.

eda_name.text: The clockmaker who built the tower was named Eda, the cleverest hands the town ever knew.

eda_hid_secret.text: Eda built the tower to keep a secret the town had nearly lost, guarded by a puzzle meant for someone patient and kind.

set_clock_opens.text: Setting the clock right opens the tower's secret; forcing it makes the tower fight back.

keeper_gave_token.text: The clockkeeper handed Mara a small brass token from his mantel, saying she would know when she needed it.

landing_inside.text: The friends dropped through the window onto a dusty wooden landing high inside the tower, a spiral stair winding down.

tower_hall.text: The tower's tall hall offers four ways on: a spiral stair, the clockmaker's study, a pendulum pit with a ledge, and stairs to a basement.

cipher_set_at_clockface.text: The cipher is to be set at the great clockface at the top of the spiral stair.

light_limited.text: The daylight is running out, so the friends cannot do everything.

gear_token_found.text: Under a loose stair tread near the top the friends find a small brass gear-token, which Mara pockets.

cipher_wheel.text: A cipher wheel, two brass discs rimmed with letters, hangs in the study and is the way to read Eda's code.

mara_can_decode.text: With the cipher wheel Mara can now decode anything Eda left.

eda_logbooks.text: The study shelves hold dozens of Eda's logbooks: decades of notes, drawings and secrets.

pendulum_still.text: A vast pendulum hangs motionless in its pit and will not swing unless the clock comes alive.

oil_can_on_ledge.text: An old oil can hangs on a hook at the far end of the narrow pendulum ledge, useful for freeing stuck gears.

has_oil_can.text: The friends crossed the ledge and carry the oil can.

no_oil_can.text: The friends do not have the oil can.

basement_lantern.text: Lin finds a fallen lantern in the basement engine room that still holds oil and lights it.

service_ladder.text: An iron service ladder in the basement runs straight up a shaft to the clockface.

clockface_symbol_ring.text: Behind the great clockface a ring of symbols in the note's alphabet runs around the hub of the hands.

cipher_names_time.text: The cipher names a time; setting the clock hands to it makes something happen.

panel_seam.text: Lin notices a seam in the brass behind the clockface, a panel that might hide another way through.

cipher_time_read.text: Mara reads off the hour and minute Eda hid in the note.

clock_set_correctly.text: The friends set the clock hands to the exact time from the cipher.

tower_has_vault.text: What Eda guarded waits in a vault in the tower, opened from behind the clockface.

vault_panel_opened.text: Setting the right time made a panel beside the clockface slide aside, opening onto a small dark room.

gears_jammed.text: Forcing the hands by guesswork jammed a row of gears, locking the mechanism half-turned.

gears_freed.text: The friends worked oil into the jammed gears and eased them loose.

second_dial.text: Behind the back panel is a tiny symbol dial with two settings: one matching the note, and a faint scratched sequence almost hidden.

hidden_workshop.text: The clockmaker has a hidden workshop that the faint sequence leads to.

vault_entered.text: The friends stand in the vault, a small round room lit through a pinhole.

sealed_letter.text: In the vault sits a folded letter sealed with wax.

automaton.text: In the vault sits a music-box automaton of a brass clockmaker at her bench.

treasure_dish.text: In the vault sits a shallow dish of old coins and small bright jewels.

tower_solved.text: The friends have solved the tower.

letter_encoded.text: Eda's final message must be decoded.

eda_story_learned.text: Reading the logbooks taught the friends more about Eda than the whole town remembered.

clock_not_set.text: The friends did not set the clock.

vault_not_found.text: The friends did not find the vault.

keeper_locks_tower.text: At day's end the clockkeeper locks the tower for the night.

cipher_half_mystery.text: The cipher is still half a mystery when the friends go home.

cipher_unsolved.text: The cipher is still unsolved when the friends leave.

spin_jammed.text: Spinning the hands at random jammed the works and set off the lock-up bell.

left_empty_handed.text: The friends leave the tower empty-handed.

damage_not_permanent.text: The jam is not permanent; oil and patience could free the clock another day.

keeper_come_back.text: The clockkeeper tells the friends the tower tests you and to come back when ready.

workshop_unfinished_work.text: Eda's hidden workshop is crammed with half-finished clockwork no one else has seen; the friends become its keepers.

letter_plain.text: Eda's letter is written in plain words.

letter_reveals_charter_spring.text: Eda's letter tells where the original town charter and the lost spring, hidden during a long-ago flood, can be found.

spring_and_charter_restored.text: The spring is found flowing again and the charter goes to the town hall; the repaired clock chimes true.

town_told.text: The friends bring Eda's message to the town.

secret_kept.text: The friends tell no one what they found in the vault and keep it as a secret among themselves.

bell_cage_trap.text: Lifting the treasure dish drops a cage of brass rods hung with jangling bells, a trap Eda built for the greedy.

treasure_returned.text: The friends put every coin and jewel back exactly where it had been.

n_open.event: Mara, Theo and Lin find a cipher note pinned to the locked door of the silent clocktower.

n_start.event: Mara reasons the note was meant to be solved; the friends choose between the note, another way in, or the clockkeeper.

n_note.event: Mara cracks the substitution cipher: a key under the third stone and a loose grate that breathes.

n_door.event: Circling the tower they find a swollen side door and a high open window with a climbing route.

n_keeper.event: The clockkeeper knows about the note, says the tower tests its entrants, and offers to unlock it or tell its maker's story.

n_keyhunt.event: Under the third stair they find an ornate brass key and carry it to the front door.

n_keeper_story.event: The keeper tells of Eda the clockmaker, who hid a town secret behind a puzzle, and gives Mara a brass token.

n_window.event: Theo climbs to the high window and the friends squeeze through onto a dusty landing inside.

n_inside.event: From the foot of the landing the friends survey the hall: spiral stair, study, pendulum pit and basement.

n_stairs.event: Climbing the spiral stair, Theo finds a brass gear-token like the one the keeper described.

n_study.event: In the study Mara finds the cipher wheel and can now decode anything; Eda's logbooks tempt them to stay.

n_pendulum.event: An oil can waits at the end of a narrow ledge past the still pendulum; cross for it or back away.

n_basement.event: Lin lights an old lantern in the basement engine room and they climb a service ladder to the clockface.

n_clockface.event: Behind the clockface Mara, holding the cipher wheel, sees the symbol ring; set carefully, force, search a panel, or spin.

n_setcorrect.event: Mara reads the hidden time with the cipher wheel; setting it opens a panel into the vault.

n_setjam.event: Theo forces the hands and jams the gears; the oil can from the pendulum ledge might free them.

n_backpanel.event: Behind the back panel a tiny dial offers the note's setting into the vault or a faint scratched sequence.

n_vault.event: In Eda's vault sit a sealed letter, an automaton and a dish of treasure; share, keep, or grab.

n_end_library.event: Lost in Eda's logbooks until the bell tolls, the friends leave without setting the clock, vowing to return.

n_end_giveup.event: Lin judges the ledge too risky; without the oil can and out of light, they go home with the cipher half solved.

n_end_timeout.event: Theo spins the hands, the works jam and the lock-up bell drives them out empty-handed.

n_end_stuck.event: Without the oil can the jam will not give; the keeper sends them home to come back ready.

n_end_secret.event: The scratched sequence opens Eda's hidden workshop of unfinished clockwork, and the friends become its keepers.

n_end_hero.event: Eda's letter reveals the lost charter and spring; the town recovers both and the clock chimes again.

n_end_keepsake.event: Mara folds the letter back along its creases and the friends keep the vault as their shared secret.

n_end_caught.event: Grabbing the treasure drops a jangling bell cage; the keeper arrives and they return every coin.

n_end_library.gift: pages of Eda's brilliance no one had read in years, and a promise to come back

n_end_giveup.gift: a safe walk home under the stars and the lesson that safety can be worth the prize

n_end_timeout.gift: the tower's iron answer that rushing is not the way: next time, Eda's way, slowly

n_end_stuck.gift: a humbling jam that is not permanent, and the keeper's invitation to be tested again

n_end_secret.gift: Eda's hidden workshop of unfinished clockwork, entrusted to the curious

n_end_hero.gift: the lost charter and spring restored to the town, and the clock chiming true again

n_end_keepsake.gift: a real mystery solved and held close, binding three friends for years

n_end_caught.gift: a ridiculous bell-cage trap and a lesson that the trap was built for the greedy

notes: The book declares no variables and no choice conditions or effects, so there are no threads; every choice is visible in every state.
Ending titles for e_library, e_secret and e_hero are unfilled placeholders in the book.
book.slug is derived from the title; the book carries no slug.
